title: AI4IA Foundry toolbox manifest
description: Declarative definition of the single Foundry Agent Service toolbox that AI4IA fronts through the official-MCP APIM (see docs/foundry-toolbox.md). scripts/provision-foundry-toolbox.py reads this file and calls project.toolboxes.create_version(name, tools=[typed ToolboxTool models], description, skills, policies). The checked-in foundry/toolbox.manifest.json is the CANONICAL definition of the live ai4ia-toolbox that a new tenant reproduces 1:1. Fields mirror the Foundry toolbox declarative contract; camelCase keys here map to the API's snake_case (the script translates).

name.description: Toolbox name (also the {toolbox_name} path segment in the MCP endpoint, and the mcp-servers.json entry name). Lowercase slug; pattern matches infra/mcp-servers.schema.json so the projected catalog entry is always valid.

description.description: Human-readable toolbox description (helps agents/operators understand its scope).

raiPolicyName.description: Optional Responsible AI policy name that must already exist on the project (maps to policies.rai_config.rai_policy_name). AI4IA's foundry.bicep provisions 'ai4ia-annotate-only'.

connections.description: Project connections the toolbox references by name (credentials live in the connection, never here). Each must already exist in the project (create with `azd ai connection create`).

tools.description: Connectionless built-in tools and MCP tools to include. The service allows at most ONE tool total to omit `name`; give every other tool a unique `name`. Add a `description` to every tool to help model tool selection.

type.description: Tool type. See docs/foundry-toolbox.md for per-tool config and regional/model limits (all preview).

name.description: Optional per-instance name; required when including multiple tools of the same type.

description.description: Optional tool description used by the model for tool selection.

toolConfigs.description: Optional per-tool visibility/search-tuning overrides (azure-ai-projects 2.3.0's base ToolboxTool.tool_configs dict[str, ToolConfig]). Keyed by the referenced tool's `name` (or `serverLabel` for mcp-family tools), or '*' as a catch-all default. Common to every tool type.

pin.description: Pin this tool so it is always available to the model regardless of selection heuristics.

additionalSearchText.description: Extra text blended into tool-selection search/ranking for this tool.

maxNumResults.description: file_search only: caps the number of results returned per query (azure-ai-projects 2.3.0's FileSearchToolboxTool.max_num_results; SDK docstring bounds it to 1-50).

rankingOptions.description: file_search only: result ranking tuning (azure-ai-projects 2.3.0's RankingOptions).

ranker.description: Ranker version (RankerVersionType). Omit to use the service default.

scoreThreshold.description: Minimum relevance score (0-1) a result must meet to be returned.

hybridSearch.description: Blend of vector/keyword search (azure-ai-projects 2.3.0's HybridSearchOptions). Both weights are Required on that SDK model when the object is present.

filters.description: Shape depends on tool type: file_search uses a comparison/compound filter tree (azure-ai-projects 2.3.0's ComparisonFilter/CompoundFilter over vector-store file metadata); web_search uses a simple allowed-domains object (WebSearchToolFilters). The exact per-type shape is enforced below; this base declaration only requires a JSON object.

userLocation.description: web_search only: approximate caller location used to localize search results (azure-ai-projects 2.3.0's WebSearchApproximateLocation). The SDK always sets `type` to the literal 'approximate' internally; it is not a settable field here.

searchContextSize.description: web_search only: how much search context the model is given per call (azure-ai-projects 2.3.0's WebSearchToolboxTool.search_context_size). Defaults to 'medium' when omitted.

serverDescription.description: mcp only: optional human-readable description of the target MCP server (azure-ai-projects 2.3.0's MCPToolboxTool.server_description).

allowedTools.description: mcp only: restricts which of the server's tools are exposed (azure-ai-projects 2.3.0's MCPToolboxTool.allowed_tools). Either a plain allow-list of tool names, or an MCPToolFilter object.

deferLoading.description: mcp only: defers loading/listing the server's tools until first referenced, instead of eagerly at toolbox-attach time (azure-ai-projects 2.3.0's MCPToolboxTool.defer_loading).

baseUrl.description: a2a_preview only: the remote agent's base URL (azure-ai-projects 2.3.0's A2APreviewToolboxTool.base_url). One of `baseUrl` or `projectConnectionId` is required; Microsoft's documented A2A walkthrough uses `projectConnectionId` (a project connection storing the endpoint + auth) -- prefer that where possible.

agentCardPath.description: a2a_preview only: path to the agent's card document, relative to `baseUrl` (azure-ai-projects 2.3.0's A2APreviewToolboxTool.agent_card_path). Defaults to '/.well-known/agent-card.json' when omitted.

sendCredentialsForAgentCard.description: a2a_preview only: whether to send the connection's credentials when fetching the agent card itself (azure-ai-projects 2.3.0's A2APreviewToolboxTool.send_credentials_for_agent_card). Defaults to false.

azureAiSearch.description: Required nested config for azure_ai_search tools, mirroring azure-ai-projects 2.3.0's AzureAISearchToolResource. Do NOT put indexName/projectConnectionId at the tool root; the SDK constructor silently drops them there.

indexes.description: The SDK currently supports at most one index per azure_ai_search tool (azure-ai-projects AzureAISearchToolResource.indexes docstring: 'maximum of 1 index resource').

items.description: Microsoft's Azure AI Search tool 'Configure tool parameters' guide lists project_connection_id and index_name as BOTH Required, with no documented alternative. The SDK model (azure-ai-projects 2.3.0 AISearchIndexResource) also exposes an index_asset_id field with no corroborating Microsoft Learn example; it is modeled here as a documented, mutually-exclusive alternative to indexName+projectConnectionId per explicit product direction, not because Learn docs demonstrate it -- see docs/foundry-toolbox.md.

customSearchConfiguration.description: Optional grounding-with-Bing-custom-search config for web_search tools, mirroring azure-ai-projects 2.3.0's WebSearchConfiguration. Both fields are Required on that SDK model (no defaults, unlike azure_ai_search's index fields). Omit `customSearchConfiguration` entirely to use the tool's default (non-custom) grounded web search.

browserAutomationPreview.description: Required nested config for browser_automation_preview tools, mirroring azure-ai-projects 2.3.0's BrowserAutomationToolParameters.

connection.description: Playwright Workspace project connection (not a plain API connection).

container.description: Optional code_interpreter execution target, mirroring azure-ai-projects 2.3.0's CodeInterpreterToolboxTool.container: an EXISTING container ID (string -- a pre-registered container resource, NOT an image reference), or the Foundry-managed auto/managed-sandbox object (AutoCodeInterpreterToolParam) with optional resource limits. Omit entirely for the plain managed sandbox. There is no toolbox-level way to run a custom/BYO container image; for genuinely custom execution logic, expose it as your own server and add it as an `mcp` tool instead.

networkPolicy.description: Optional outbound network policy, mirroring azure-ai-projects 2.3.0's ContainerNetworkPolicyParam (disabled | allowlist). The SDK's allowlist variant also supports `domainSecrets` (per-domain literal secret values injected into the sandbox); AI4IA intentionally does NOT expose that field here because this manifest is committed to source control -- see docs/foundry-toolbox.md's secrets policy.

vectorStoreIds.description: Required-if-present vector store IDs to search (azure-ai-projects 2.3.0's FileSearchToolboxTool.vector_store_ids). The SDK allows omitting it, but a file_search tool with an empty list is inert, so if present it must be non-empty.

openapi.description: Required nested function definition for openapi tools, mirroring azure-ai-projects 2.3.0's OpenApiFunctionDefinition. `spec` is an arbitrary, externally-authored OpenAPI document; scripts/provision-foundry-toolbox.py passes its contents through UNMODIFIED (property names inside spec are never rewritten, so e.g. a JSON-schema property genuinely named `topK` survives as `topK`). `additionalProperties: false` here deliberately rejects `functions`: OpenApiFunctionDefinition.functions is declared `rest_field(visibility=["read"])` in the locked SDK -- it is server-populated (extracted from `spec`) and is stripped from every request body by `ToolboxesOperations.create_version()`'s `exclude_readonly=True` JSON encoding, so accepting it as a caller-settable manifest field would be a silently-inert, success-shaped no-op rather than a real configuration knob.

name.description: The function name the model calls (OpenApiFunctionDefinition.name).

spec.description: Opaque OpenAPI 3.x document. NOT validated or key-rewritten by this schema/script -- authored and owned by the API being described.

auth.description: OpenApiAuthDetails, matching azure-ai-projects 2.3.0's discriminated auth models exactly (each branch is fully closed -- no extra/credential-like keys of any kind, per type, are accepted): OpenApiAnonymousAuthDetails takes ONLY `type` (the SDK constructor has no other parameter at all, so e.g. a stray `securityScheme` or `token` alongside `anonymous` is rejected, not silently ignored); OpenApiProjectConnectionAuthDetails/OpenApiManagedAuthDetails each require a `securityScheme` object holding exactly the one field their SDK security-scheme class defines (`projectConnectionId` / `audience` respectively) and nothing else.

defaultParams.description: OpenAPI spec parameter names that use the caller-provided defaults instead of model-chosen values.

serverLabel.description: Required identifier for mcp tools (used to identify the tool in tool calls; also what satisfies the 'at most one unnamed tool' rule for mcp, in place of `name`). Also an optional field on fabric_iq_preview.

serverUrl.description: mcp tool target URL (one of `serverUrl`/`connectorId` required). Also an optional field on fabric_iq_preview (defaults to the connection's own URL when omitted there).

connectorId.description: mcp tool built-in service connector (alternative to `serverUrl`). One of `serverUrl` or `connectorId` is required.

projectConnectionId.description: Tool-root project connection, genuinely a top-level SDK field (unlike azure_ai_search/browser_automation_preview, which nest it) for: mcp (optional), a2a_preview (one of projectConnectionId/baseUrl required), fabric_iq_preview (required), work_iq_preview (required, and the only field that type accepts).

requireApproval.description: Tool-call approval policy for mcp / fabric_iq_preview tools: the literal 'always'/'never', or a per-tool-name MCPToolRequireApproval object with independent 'always'/'never' MCPToolFilter buckets (azure-ai-projects 2.3.0). Defaults to 'always' when omitted.

skills.description: Existing project skills to bind to the toolbox as MCP resources. Create them first with scripts/provision-foundry-skills.py (or `azd ai skill create`).

version.description: Optional skill version to pin (string). Omit to use the skill's default version.

mcpToolFilter.description: azure-ai-projects 2.3.0's MCPToolFilter: an allow-list of tool names and/or a read-only-only restriction.

comparisonFilter.description: azure-ai-projects 2.3.0's ComparisonFilter: a single metadata comparison.

compoundFilter.description: azure-ai-projects 2.3.0's CompoundFilter: a boolean combination of nested filters.

fileSearchFilter.description: file_search `filters`: either a single comparison or a compound (and/or) tree of filters.
